name: Shivers: A Winter Getaway
source:
After weeks of anticipation, tomorrow is finally the day where you can spend time with your family in a nice cabin in the woods. Except when you wake up, things are different, and your parents are acting strange. Is it the cold that's getting to them, or something else entirely? Will you be able to get out of the tricky situations they put you in, or will you freeze under pressure?

[From [url=https://unknown-minnow.itch.io/shivers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
盼了好幾個星期，明天終於能和家人一起去森林裡舒舒服服的小木屋度假了。可一覺醒來，一切都不太對勁，連父母的舉止都很古怪。是天太冷了，還是另有隱情？他們接連給你出了難題，你能設法脫身，還是會凍在原地，什麼也做不了？

［摘自[url=https://unknown-minnow.itch.io/shivers]itch.io[/url]］
